paragraph: Can I see the special **exhibit** with this ticket? I'm going to **exhibit** my roses at the flower show. He was kind enough to guide me through the **exhibit**.
english: an instance of exhibiting

paragraph: I must **adjust** my watch. It's slow. At first he had trouble **adjusting** to living in his new house. Give your eyes time to **adjust** to the dark.
english: to change slightly to fit or work better
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن أضبط ساعتي. إنها بطيئة.

paragraph: A **column** of white smoke rose into the sky. The opinion **column** discusses the importance of voting. The names are in the first **column**.
english: a vertical line of entries in a table, usually read from top to bottom

paragraph: Don't touch the wound, you could get an **infection**! The spread of the **infection** is very dangerous. Should China allow the **infection** to spread?
english: the act or process of infecting

paragraph: Everyone in the class learned the **poem** by heart. It is difficult to translate a **poem** into another language. Is this a **poem**? My French isn't good enough to tell.
english: literary piece written in verse
arabicDesc: مثال: حفظ جميع من في الصف القصيدة عن ظهر قلب.

paragraph: The **creature** had black skin. The **creatures** reached for me. I wonder what I did to upset that **creature**.
english: living being
arabicDesc: مثال: كان جلد ذلك المخلوق أسودا.

paragraph: Look on both sides of the **shield**. Can you **shield** me from this? The army use civilians as human **shields**.
english: anything that protects or defends
arabicDesc: مثال: انظر إلى جانبي الدرع.

paragraph: This is a world where the sun doesn't **shine**. The clouds cleared up and let the sun **shine**. So long as the stars **shine**, there is hope.
english: to emit or reflect light so as to glow
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ومض

paragraph: That song was a real **blast** from the past. I had a **blast** at the party last night. A **blast** of cold air came through the door.
english: an explosion

paragraph: We have the **reputation** of this clinic to protect. He has a bad **reputation** with his students. He got the **reputation** for being an honest politician.
english: what somebody is known for
arabicDesc: مثال: علينا حماية سمعة هذه العيادة.

paragraph: I addressed my full attention to the **landscape** outside. This summit offers stunning views of the surrounding **landscape**. Words to describe the beauty of this **landscape** fail me.
english: a portion of land or territory as defined by its landform, its geographical (and architectural) features
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: منظر

paragraph: Her **arrival** came as a huge surprise to us. The **arrival** of the troops led to more violence. I received a letter informing me of his **arrival**.
english: act of arriving
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: وفادة

paragraph: Take off your school **uniform**. We wear **uniforms** at our school. When was the last time you wore a **uniform**?
english: distinctive outfit as a means of identifying members of a group
arabicDesc: مثال: اخلع زيك المدرسي.

paragraph: Do not hold on to **possessions** you no longer need. I have never had more than $500 in my **possession**. Be responsible with your phone, it's a valuable **possession**.
english: a control or occupancy of something for which one does not necessarily have private property rights
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحتفظْ بمتاعٍ لم يعدْ لك فيه حاجة.

other.meaning: control or occupancy without legal ownership
ownership; taking, holding, keeping something as one's own

paragraph: Cancer can be **cured** if discovered in time. This medicine **cured** me of my cold. You think that you can **cure** yourself, don't you?
english: a method, device or medication that restores good health
arabicDesc: مثال: من الممكن علاج السرطان إذا اكتشف قبل فوات الأوان.

paragraph: Did your **uncle** let you drive his car? My **uncle** is the only person who uses this word. My **uncle** talks about you all the time.
english: brother (or brother-in-law) of someone’s parent
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سمح لك عمك أن تقود سيارته؟

paragraph: How **dare** you say such a thing to me? Don't you even **dare** call me. How **dare** you insult my sister!
english: to have courage
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف تجرؤ على قول شيء كهذا لي؟

other.meaning: to brave or face up to

paragraph: The boy battled against a serious **illness**. He talked about her **illness**. His **illness** may be cancer.
english: an instance of a disease or poor health
arabicDesc: مثال: كان ذلك الفتى يصارع مرضا خطيرا.

paragraph: Many people pushed their way toward the rear **exit**. That building has no emergency **exit**. Try to find an **exit** strategy.
english: an act of going out or going away, or leaving
arabicDesc: مثال: الكثير من الناس شقوا طريقهم باتجاه المخرج الخلفي.

other.meaning: action of going out or going away, or leaving — see also departure
To go out or go away from a place or situation (verb)

paragraph: There are some things that are difficult to **translate**. After you **translate** this article, send it to me. How long did it take you to **translate** this book?
english: to change spoken words or written text from one language to another
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك بعض الأشياء التى من الصعب ترجمتها.

paragraph: When you **pose** a question, you expect an answer. I don't **pose** a danger to myself or to others. Don't **pose** for your picture until the contest is over.
english: position, posture, arrangement (especially of the human body)
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: وضع

paragraph: I don't like to see you **shouting** in her face. You were **shouting** at her and I don't like that. Why are you **shouting** at my mother?!
english: to utter a sudden and loud outcry
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحب أن أراك تصرخ في وجهها.

paragraph: The road is getting **narrow**. The path was very **narrow**. The road is **narrower** now.
english: having small width
arabicDesc: مثال: الطريق يضيق.

paragraph: The **bishop** spoke, but he avoided addressing the issue. The **bishop** talked without commenting on the situation. A **bishop** can never end up on an opposite-colored square.
english: a chief of the Festival of Fools or St. Nicholas Day

paragraph: This discovery has the potential to **transform** the field. Light is able to **transform** space and location. Can we **transform** Mars into a warm and green planet?
english: to change greatly the appearance or form of
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مسخ

paragraph: That single **pipe** supplies the entire house with water. You can smoke a **pipe** when you grow up. There were some **pipe** issues in the bathroom.
english: meanings relating to a wind instrument

paragraph: Your whole life is a complete **disaster**. Just look at her, she looks like a **disaster**! They responded quickly to maintain order during the **disaster**.
english: an unfortunate or unpleasant occurrence, especially one resulting from an accident or something going wrong
arabicDesc: مثال: إنّ حياتك كارثّية بالكامل.

paragraph: I think it's a **horror** movie. My brother likes **horror** movies. When it comes to movies I like anything, as long as it's not **horror**.
english: intense distressing fear or repugnance
arabicDesc: مثال: أظن أن هذا فيلم رعب.

paragraph: All the sciences are branches from the same **stem**. Physical reactions often **stem** from emotional triggers. That's where all your issues **stem** from.
english: the stock of a family

paragraph: His daily behavior is not **consistent** with his principles. He's a very **consistent** worker. He rarely makes mistakes. When learning languages, it's important to stay **consistent**.
english: of a regularly occurring, dependable nature

paragraph: **Meanwhile**, many more people fell, one after the other. **Meanwhile** you are out and about with her! **Meanwhile**, I want to draw your attention to a point.
english: during the time that something is happening, often specifically in a different place

other.arabic: إلى حين ذلك الوقت في الأثناء

other.meaning: in contrast or opposed to aspects previously mentioned

paragraph: Death is something that just happens **naturally** in life. **Naturally** we will be careful to avoid an accident. Dogs have **naturally** evolved a great sense of smell.
english: of course; in a natural way

paragraph: Things that you see with your eyes are not **necessarily** true. It is not **necessarily** true that what the teacher says is always correct. It is not **necessarily** so.
english: of necessity
arabicDesc: مثال: ما تراه عيناك ليس بالضرورة الحقيقة.

paragraph: So you're not trying to get in her **pants**? I broke the fly on another pair of **pants**. There is a cat on fire in my **pants**!
english: a piece of clothing that covers each leg separately

paragraph: I have no **practical** reason for learning this language. Such skills could be put to many **practical** uses. He wasn't perhaps playing a **practical** joke on us.
english: relating to, or based on, practice or action rather than theory or hypothesis

other.meaning: being likely to be effective and applicable to a real situation

paragraph: A happy life **primarily** consists of freedom from worry. This production is **primarily** aimed at the American market. They were **primarily** interested in the creation of the universe.
english: mainly

paragraph: You can take part in the meeting **regardless** of your age. **Regardless** whether it's a lie or the truth, I won't believe you. **Regardless** of this, I am not able to sleep.
english: without being affected by something
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكانك المشاركة في الاجتماع بغض النظر عن سنك.

paragraph: I am going to play **soccer** tomorrow. Some people like baseball, others like **soccer**. All of my friends like **soccer**.
english: association football
arabicDesc: مثال: غدا سوف ألعب كرة القدم.

paragraph: You must be the **temporary** we asked for. You'll need a **temporary** bridge. I made a **temporary** repair to the broken door.
english: for a limited time, ephemeral, not constant
arabicDesc: مثال: لا بد أنك البديل المؤقت الذي طلبناه.

paragraph: Our governments have become space **aliens** living among a human population. Let's pretend we are **aliens**. It had an effect **alien** from the one intended.
english: a person, animal, plant, or other thing which is from outside the family, group, organization, or territory under consideration
arabicDesc: مثال: باتت حكوماتنا كائناً فضائياً يعيش وسط شعب أرضي.

paragraph: I have never known the string **snap** on me. You don't have to **snap** at me like that. I've never been able to **snap** my fingers.
english: to break suddenly; to speak angrily; to take a photo

paragraph: Was the Fifth **Amendment** made to protect the innocent? The **amendment** was first proposed in 1789. This is a very significant **amendment**.
english: an alteration or change for the better

paragraph: Our **rockets** are too slow. The **rocket** blew up a few seconds after launch. They knew to an inch where the **rocket** would land.
english: a projectile
arabicDesc: مثال: صواريخنا بطيئة جدا.

paragraph: In the **palace** live the king and the queen. The **palace** doors opened to reveal the grand hall. All the tourists come here to see the **palace**.
english: official residence of a head of state or other dignitary, especially in a monarchical or imperial governmental system
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بلاط، سراي

paragraph: Her **charm** does not consist only in her beauty. I don't believe that I have such great **charm**. The greatest **charm** of traveling lies in its new experiences.
english: a pleasant quality that attracts people

paragraph: The bird was half as large as an **eagle**. The little bird couldn't defend itself against the **eagle**. The **eagle** extended its wings, ready to take flight.
english: any of several large carnivorous and carrion-eating birds in the family Accipitridae, having a powerful hooked bill and keen vision

paragraph: I've never felt the need to explore that **avenue**. Yesterday, we took a walk on this narrow **avenue**. This **avenue** is wide but not very long.
english: a way or opening for entrance into a place

paragraph: The mail **carrier** delivers mail from door to door. He works on an aircraft **carrier** as a cook. The letter **carrier** is bound to come soon.
english: a person or object that carries someone or something else

other.meaning: person or organism that has inherited a trait or disease but displays no symptoms

paragraph: I **allege** that you are wrong, so I don't want to say a word anymore. The boss is **alleged** to have hit a worker. Recently, he's come under fire for **alleged** tax fraud.
english: to adduce (something) as a reason, excuse, support etc

paragraph: The **duke** holds a lot of land. The **duke** extended his hand for the dance. The Grand-**Duke** received the ambassadors in audience.
english: male ruler of a duchy
arabicDesc: مثال: الدوق يمتلك الكثير من الأراضي.

paragraph: Please hold down the **fort** until we get back. This old **fort** will be very difficult to protect. The chief massed his warriors to attack the **fort**.
english: a fortified defensive structure stationed with troops
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حصن

paragraph: There were at most twenty people at the **rally**. This message definitely feels like something to **rally** around. I'm going to a monster truck **rally**.
english: a public gathering or mass meeting that is not mainly a protest and is organized to inspire enthusiasm for a cause
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مظاهرة، تظاهر

paragraph: She was not in the **mood** for serious books. It depends on my **mood**. You seem to be in a bad **mood** today.
english: mental state
arabicDesc: مثال: لم تكن في المزاج المناسب للكتب الجادة.

paragraph: We should not **impose** our opinions on other people. I'm not the type to **impose** myself on others. Are you going to **impose** these rules on yourself?
english: to force a rule or tax on someone

paragraph: The **translation** of the French novel took him more than three months. I will change this **translation**. We want natural-sounding **translations**, not word-for-word direct **translations**.
english: act of translating between languages
arabicDesc: مثال: استغرقت ترجمته للرواية الفرنسية أكثر من ثلاثة أشهر.

paragraph: Perhaps you would have preferred a French **dish**. The **dishes** got sent to the wrong table. You will wash **dishes**, won't you?
english: vessel for holding/serving food
arabicDesc: مثال: ربما، كنت لتفضل طبقًا فرنسيا.

paragraph: He loves to watch **playoff** basketball. Our team did not reach the **playoffs** this year. The Giants finally made it to the **playoffs**.
english: a game played to decide a winner

paragraph: Military life is different from **civilian** life. A number of soldiers were wearing **civilian** clothes. The territory has no permanent **civilian** population.
english: non-military person
arabicDesc: مثال: الحياة العسكريّة مختلفة عن الحياة المدنيّة.

other.meaning: Not related to the military, police or other governmental professions (adjective)

paragraph: I am convinced that he is **innocent**. We are not the only ones who believe that he is **innocent**. He was **innocent** of the crime.
english: pure, free from sin, untainted
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا مقتنع أنه بريء.

other.meaning: not legally responsible for a wrongful act

paragraph: Children reflect the family **atmosphere**. The **atmosphere** was filled with hope and positive energy. Mars is a large rock with a thin **atmosphere**.
english: gases surrounding the Earth
arabicDesc: مثال: الأطفال مرآة للجو العائلي.

paragraph: Her illness is not such as to cause **anxiety**. She was waiting for her son with great **anxiety**. His **anxiety** was such that he could hardly sleep.
english: an unpleasant state of mental uneasiness, nervousness, apprehension and obsession or concern about some uncertain event

paragraph: Why do I keep pressing the **audio** button? This was the best **audio** I've ever heard! This segment of the **audio** contains too much background noise.
english: focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أوديو

paragraph: Women love talking about **clothing**. He made out really well in the **clothing** business. This **clothing** of mine has gone out of fashion.
english: an act or instance of putting clothes on
arabicDesc: مثال: النساء يحبن الحديث عن الملابس.

paragraph: It's more **complicated** than that. My language is very **complicated**. The social problems of the day tend to be more and more **complicated**.
english: difficult or convoluted
arabicDesc: مثال: الأمر أكثر تعقيدا.

paragraph: In **everyday** life no one speaks in verse. I'm constantly keeping a close eye on **everyday** news. **Everyday** this old man brings with him a stick.
english: normal and usual
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يتكلم احداً بالابيات الشعرية في الحياة اليومية .

paragraph: Do you love each other to that **extent**? I agree with what you say to some **extent**. This is at best the **extent** of my magic.
english: a range of values or locations
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تحبان بعضكما بعضاً إلى ذلك الحد؟

paragraph: Do you have experience working in the **healthcare** sector? The American **healthcare** system leaves much to be desired. Abortion **healthcare**, like all **healthcare**, is a human right.
english: the services that care for people's health

paragraph: This study compares the **immigration** policies of various nations. Illegal **immigration** is a serious problem in this country. We have to introduce ourselves to the **immigration** office.
english: the act of immigrating
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مهاجرة، هجار

paragraph: I've seen things a lot more **impressive** than this. Unless it's something fairly **impressive**, I won't remember it. The things you could see from there were **impressive**.
english: making people admire it

paragraph: Everyone has the right to **recognition** everywhere as a person before the law. The world has paid due **recognition** to her ability. I was surprised at her immediate **recognition** of me.
english: praise for an achievement; also knowing someone again
arabicDesc: مثال: لكل إنسان أينما وجد الحق في أن يعترف بشخصيته القانونية.

paragraph: I'll find out **shortly** whether or not you lied. We got into an accident **shortly** before the play. The doctor will be in to see you **shortly**.
english: soon

paragraph: He **strongly** cried out asking for help. I would advise you **strongly** to quit doing that. I **strongly** suggest that you get yourself another lawyer.
english: in a strong way
arabicDesc: مثال: صرخ بقوة في حين يطلب المساعدة.

paragraph: Chinese businesses are perfectly entitled to purchase **infrastructure** in Europe. The **infrastructure** of an application is directly related to its overall performance. Chinese investment plays a growing role in the **infrastructure** and energy sectors.
english: an underlying base or foundation for a building, organization, or system

paragraph: She gets about with the help of a **walker**. Do you put the child in a **walker**? I saw an old man with a **walker**.
english: the agent noun of to walk: a person who walks or a thing which walks, especially a pedestrian or a participant in a walking race

paragraph: A **bug** hit the window. The **bug** is still alive. The **bug** was almost as big as a dog.
english: an insect of the order Hemiptera (the “true bugs”)
arabicDesc: مثال: اصطدمت الحشرة بالنافذة.

paragraph: You had the opportunity to **enhance** your performance. Different opinions can **enhance** our understanding. Improved conditions **enhance** quality of life.
english: to improve something

paragraph: I don't have enough money to pay the **mortgage** off. Who can explain to me what a **mortgage** credit is? The bank holds a **mortgage** on his building.
english: a legal agreement in which a borrower pledges real property as collateral for a loan used to purchase or refinance that property
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: رهن عقاري

paragraph: Where are the documents that were on my **desk**? A cat came out from under the **desk**. That **desk** does not fit in this room.
english: table for writing and reading
arabicDesc: مثال: أين هي الوثائق التي كانت على طاولتي؟

paragraph: The **output** at this factory has increased by 20%. **Output** by 1999 had fallen to less than 40% of the 1991 level. Agriculture accounts for one-fifth of **output** and two-fifths of employment.
english: that which is produced by something, especially that which is produced within a particular time period or from a particular effort

other.meaning: data sent out of the computer

paragraph: You people go ahead. We'll bring up the **rear**. My mother worked hard in order to **rear** us. Please move to the **rear** of the bus.
english: being behind, or in the hindmost part
arabicDesc: مثال: ايها الناس امضوا قدماً . نحن سوف نتبعكم .

paragraph: Try to get more **exposure** to your target language. My skin is burning from too much sun **exposure**. I would prefer a room with a southern **exposure**.
english: being in contact with something, such as sun or danger

paragraph: This **phrase** will be translated. Can it be **phrased** in another way? I used the **phrase** she suggested in my poem.
english: short written or spoken expression
arabicDesc: مثال: ستُترجَم هذه العبارة.

paragraph: Scientists are slowly piecing together the **mechanism** of aging. We don't have a **mechanism** for sustained funding. In what way do they activate this **mechanism**?
english: any mechanical means for the conversion or control of motion, or the transmission or control of power

paragraph: **Elite** soldiers might be trained in secret locations. The banking **elite** don't want you to use cash. Why? **Elite** soldiers are almost always selected among the special forces.
english: group with higher status
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكن أن تتدرب قوات النخبة في أماكن سرية.

paragraph: A stone does not **float**. Didn't you know that oil **floats** on water? Bill, if you'll come with me, you'll **float**, too.
english: to be supported by a fluid of greater density (than the object)
arabicDesc: مثال: الحجارة لا تطفو.

paragraph: I did not want to **alarm** you. Did you set the **alarm** clock? He can fix the **alarm** system.
english: summons to arms
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أكن أريد أن أفزعك.

paragraph: Your **friendship** means a lot to me. This is where our **friendship** ends. I appreciate our **friendship** very much.
english: the condition of being friends
arabicDesc: مثال: صداقتك تعني لي الكثير.

paragraph: China managed to **integrate** itself with the West. He plans to **integrate** real-world scenarios into his lessons. German companies offer language courses in order to **integrate** guest workers.
english: to combine things or people into one

paragraph: I want a **sword** like this! Islam isn't spread by the **sword**. The **sword** can be used to protect the body.
english: a suit in certain playing card decks, particularly those used in Spain and Italy, or those used for divination
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد السيف، مثل هذا!

paragraph: The handle of this **pan** is easy to hold. Out of the frying **pan** and into the fire. I think we should buy a new frying **pan**.
english: a wide, flat receptacle used around the house, especially for cooking

other.meaning: To wash in a pan (of earth, sand etc. when searching for gold) (verb)

paragraph: We are going downtown to eat **pizza**. My father likes **pizza** very much. What's your favorite type of **pizza**?
english: italian dish
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن ذاهبون إلى وسط المدينة لنأكل البيتزا.

paragraph: I'm looking forward to your visit during summer **vacation**. It is time for me to take a **vacation**. Because it was summer **vacation**, I took a trip.
english: period of leisure time
arabicDesc: مثال: انا اترقب زيارتك خلال العطلة الصيفية .

paragraph: He was burning with his **anger**. He could not control his **anger**. I have a lot of **anger** issues right now.
english: to become angry
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يغلي من الغضب

other.meaning: to cause such a feeling of antagonism

paragraph: Go and speak to my **colleague**. Say what you want in clear words, dear **colleague**. My **colleague** arranged the work files for me.
english: a fellow member of a profession, staff, academic faculty or other organization
arabicDesc: مثال: اذهب وتحدّث إلى زملائي.

paragraph: I had to work on an **essay**. Can you read the rough draft of my **essay**? I know that you have an **essay** to write.
english: a written composition of moderate length, exploring a particular issue or subject
arabicDesc: مثال: كان علي أن أكتب إنشاءا.

paragraph: We had a **racist** teacher. We are not afraid of this **racist** group. I'm not **racist**, but I just don't like you people.
english: person who believes a particular race is superior to others.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان لدينا مدرّس عنصري.

other.meaning: Constituting, exhibiting, advocating, or pertaining to racism (adjective)

paragraph: The fish swims by moving its **tail**. A cow has a long **tail**. He went off with his **tail** between his legs.
english: appendage of an animal — see also dock
arabicDesc: مثال: تسبح السمكة بتحريك ذيلها.

paragraph: A smile is a **curve** that sets everything straight. I don't know how to throw a **curve** ball. How do you make the ball **curve** like that?
english: a bend, such as in a road

paragraph: You are to **apologize** to her for it. She's probably just waiting for you to **apologize**. There is no reason for me to **apologize**.
english: to make an apology or excuse
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تعتذر لها منه.

paragraph: She thinks he's the **sexiest** man she has ever met. You're the smartest, **sexiest**, most beautiful woman I've ever met. Your voice sounds **sexiest** in the morning.
english: having sex appeal
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جنسي، مثير للشهوة، سيكسي
